items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: What happened with Woody, which prior to Woody I was with Nat Adderley. Nat had just formed a group after Cannonball died.

ctx.x: Yeah, oh yeah, I’ve got a whole back down. What happened with Woody, which prior to Woody I was with Nat Adderley. Nat had just formed a group after Cannonball died. And of course you know that Nat and Cannonball came to the college.
Yes, I do, I remember I had to play in front of them.
